##### 
Revised PAN Application Forms w.e.f 01stApril 2026
  

  
As per directives received from the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), the following actions shall be taken in respect of PAN applications pending under discrepancies:   
  
**Instructions for PAN Applications Pending with Discrepancies.**  
1. All PAN applications pending under discrepancies or incomplete documentation shall be mandatorily closed by 30th March 2026.  
2. Applicants are advised to submit the required documentary proof in respect of pending PAN applications under discrepancies or incomplete documentation on or before 30th March 2026. In case the required documents are not submitted within the stipulated timeline, such PAN applications shall stand rejected and disposed of without any further notice.
